title: Ocean Dye
summary: Single-use dye gives compatible equipment an ocean palette.

fields.Use: Combine it with eligible equipment in inventory. Changes the colour and leaves the stats unchanged.
fields.Acquisition: Buy from traders such as Arron and Quartermaster Talli.
fields.Base value: 3 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
